column2: On to Obojan!
Brilliant, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is invincible.  Resupply and attack towards Kursk before the Soviets can recover!
Incredible, Herr General, simply incredible.  The Allies are falling back.  However, we have another task for you...
Herr General, you have allowed enemy troops to remain on the sacred soil of the Fatherland.
Your failure will have implications for our winter counterattack.
Herr General, your capture of Liege has changed the course of the war in the west. Take advantage of this at once and procced with your next objective.

Congratulations on taking Berchtesgaden!!!

Commander, it seems that the Krauts really do not like to be cornered in Tunisia. Both Von Arnim and Rommel armies have just started an offensive aimed at our positions in south-west Tunisia. It will be tough for our boys who still lack a decent battle experience. Try your best to stop the Rommel forces that are to attack El Guettar and then Gafsa, my young leader, but pay attention for the powerful armoured units on the way.
Sebkret en Noual : SALT LAKE
Chott el Guettar : SALT LAKE
You did it commander! Even if with a lot of casualties, we got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.

General, western and southern Sicily are totally under our control, but the Krauts have put up a stubborn defence trying to avoid us to reach the Messina Strait. While the British are fighting to seize Catania, on the eastern side of the front, our task is to break the enemy positions along the western path of the island, forcing the Axis to evacuate Sicily. Expect a very well entrenched enemy and heavy air defence resistance. Let's jump to the Strait!
The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was tough, but your boys really showed their stuff. Good, very good, commander.
This operation was a snafu from the start, commander. The United States Army doesn't have the time or the patience to put up with such ineptitude. Do me a personal favor and get outta here!
Now it's time for Phase II.  We must finish up this assault before the British can rest their beaten army.  One final push south to Medinine and Tunisia will be ours.

Herr General, we have the opportunity of hitting the Russians as they move imprudently towards the west.  Do not fail us here Herr General !!!

Herr General the Western Allies have landed on Salerno. You have to throw them into the sea before our Italian Allies will capitulate!!!

Great work to you and your regiment Bob!!! Under the most difficult of conditions we have gained a toehold on the continent.

Great stuff Bob!! Congratulations to you and your Regiment. The 101st Division has captured the strategically important town of Carentan and now we can link with the assault force coming inland from Omaha Beach.

So far so good Bob!! Your division has taken it's objectives all except the canal bridge at Son which the enemy blew before we could take it. Hopefully the Engineers can get a makeshift bridge across to allow the advance of the 30th Corps to continue.
The 82nd has 2 of their three bridges secure and will launch an attack on the northern Nijmegan bridge tomorrow.
The British ran into heavy resistance north of Arnhem and haven't yet reached the city but will be bulstered by a second paradrop tomorrow.
Your division has held it's objectives and fought off several counter-attacks, well done to you and your men.
The 82nd has taken the Nijmegan bridge and the way to Arnhem is clear.
The British are hanging on and will be saved by the 30th Corps when they arrive.
Great work by all!!!

Although you held open the road, the British 1st Airborne Division was devastated at Arnhem. The battle has not been declared a total failure, but we doubt the Airborne Divisions will be used in this capacity again in this war.
Congratulations to you and your men Bob!! The northern front line has been held and we are in a good position to strike a blow to the heart of the Third Reich.
The Germans are on the run now!!

Our division has now been fully redrawn from Russia to Montauban/Toulouse in France and is renamed to SS Panzer Division "Das Reich". Our main concern is the large number of fresh troops (9000) in Das Reich - we even had to accept conscripts to fill our ranks.
- Capture the VHs in the North (leading to Normandy) and do not let the resistance take over too many towns.

Good job.
Unbelievable, that was a tough job but you pulled it off.
You have driven the Russians deep into the desert surrounding Agedabia.  No time for rest, you must continue the assault.
von Beck: Sir, after three hours of interrogating the Soviet General, we are convinced that he really does not know the whereabouts of the Generalissimo of the Red Army.

Unterfeldwebel Hardegen (Alpha Company Platoon Leader): Sir, these Bolsheviks are evil! I saw pregnant women hanging by their feet in the Soviet prison. Their noses, ears, arms - anything that stuck out - were slit. Some had their hearts cut out. Little boys and girls were nailed to the wall and butchered. For the love of God, Sir, we have to stop this. Quickly!
The Allies try to kick the Germans out of the fortified city of Metz.
The American forces have been defeated!  All of North Africa is now under our control.  The American missile base has been destroyed and is no longer a threat.
A large British army has been spotted in Israel, proceed there at once.

The position of the Greek First Army, still fighting in Albania, was seriously jeopardized by the rapid advance of the XL Panzer Corps via Florina and by the British withdrawal to positions behind the Aliakmon. The Greek command therefore had to come to grips with the necessity of withdrawing southward from Albania. However, it was not until 13 April that the first Greek elements began to withdraw toward the Pindus Mountains. On the next day an advance detachment of the 73d Infantry Division encountered Greek troops withdrawing from Albania across the Pindus Mountains into the area west of Kastoria. Heavy fighting took place on that and the following day, especially at Kastoria Pass, where the Germans blocked the Greek withdrawal, which by then extended to the entire Albanian front, with the Italians in hesitant pursuit.

On 19 April the Leibstandarte which had meanwhile reached Grevena was ordered to advance southeastward in the direction of Yannina to cut off the Greeks' route of withdrawal to the south and complete their encirclement.

The Soviets attempt to break the German siege of Leningrad.
Very well done General!
We have completed the Italian Campaign.  Italy is once again a part of the German empire.
Although you have achieved a victory, the British have delayed you long enough to strengthen their defenses in Lebanon.  You can not waste any more time.  You must finish the British off.
I will give you one more chance to prove yourself. Do not dissapoint us again.
Turkey is almost free again from the Soviets.  The enemy has retreated up the coast to Ari Burnu.
Now that Libya is secured we can prepare for the Egyptian offensive.
With the British on the run there is no time to rest.  We must press the attack and drive the British out of Tunisia before they have time to entrench themselves in their poorly constructed defenses.
You succeeded in destroying the entrenched Soviet Bunker Artillery but allowed the remnants of the enemy army to escape to Tobruk which will contain the strongest defenses you have encountered yet.
The Americans have retreated up the coast; for now.  Prepare your defenses for an expected counterattack.
No time to rest.  You need to finish the Egyptian offensive while the Americans continue to retreat.

One of our commando teams was able to rescue him, but is now encircled by Soviet troops. Lead your men in and rescue them before the Soviets can recapture them. On a more pleasant note, the Germans have joined us in the fight against communism after the success of the Polish operation.
Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism.

In the winter of 1939, Finland was invaded by the Soviet Union.  The Finns, although vastly outnumbered, were determined to defend their country.  The Soviet High Command hoped to "cut Finland in two" by driving past the key road junction of Suomussalmi and continuing to the Baltic Sea.  The Finnish commander, von Mannerheim, believed the Soviet attack had to be stopped at Suomussalmi, or his nation was doomed.
The Finnish forces have trapped one Soviet division in and around Suomussalmi, but an even more powerful Soviet relief force is moving to their aid.

Your task is to lead your "all volunteer" SS Panzer Divisions south and capture the approaches to Barcelona.  The Republicans have an enormous force in place to prevent this, destroy them and any others that get in your way.
Humph....  Herr General, you did manage to defeat the Poles, but you are behind schedule.  Your forces are no longer in the vanguard of our assault.  This will not do.
You will be given another opportunity at Warszawa.  Make the most of it!
These Poles are madmen!
Who would have expected such resistance in a futile effort?
Well you have taken their capital; they won't be capable of continuing the fight much longer.
General, this situation right now is desperate.  The Finnish Army requires you to defeat this enemy horde and turn the tide against the Soviets.  Remember to wear only your Finnish uniforms!
Take back the city of Raate and while you are there, teach the Soviets a little Blitzkrieg!
General, in these frigid conditions, you must capture Gjovik.  Finish this battle so we may go south where it is warm!
Intelligence thinks there may already be British forces in Norway, be careful!
You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas.
Do not fail us again Herr General.
Herr General, you must proceed west towards the coast as quickly as possible.  If you can reach it before June, you will cut the British and French forces in two.
Intelligence reports that both the French and the British are moving armored divisions to stop you.
Make haste to the coast, Herr General!
Well Herr General, some in the General Staff thought we were taking a risk extending our Panzer forces so far forward, perhaps they were right.
How quickly will you be able to attack again?
We must seize Dunkirk as soon as possible.
The British Expeditionary Force is making a last stand at Dunkirk.  They are starting to evacuate much of their army back to England.
Intelligence reports they have assembled a powerful army to delay you.
Destroy them now before they get away!
Congratulations, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is the pride of Germany!  Rather than waste your forces further, we are moving your army to the east for rest and refitting.
Herr General, Barbarossa has begun!

The German army has made significant progress.  Your PanzerKorps must complete an encirclement by capturing Ternopil' from the east.  Of course, in the process, destroy the Soviet forces defending it.
I'm sure your pitiful excuse for failing to take Zhytomyr will prove quite amusing.
I suggest you do not fail me again.
Ah.. Herr General.
Please observe the map.
Can you see Kyiv?
Why aren't your there!
Get out of my sight until I can find something you're good for!
Herr General, you succeeded.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective, Moskva.
Fine performance, Herr General.  With Khar'kov in our hands we can hold the front.
Herr General, welcome to Normandy. The British and Americans have assembled a huge force, and they will try to break out.  You must stop them.  Defend the Fatherland at all costs!
Impressive. Despite the fact the enemy has managed to force their way inland at all other points, you have stopped them here. You have done very well, Herr General.
Herr General, your thrust to Liege will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow, you have changed the course of the war in the west. Outstanding.

Herr General, your progress is impressive.  You must now capture your second objective: Bruxelles.  Make haste, there are impressive forces arrayed against you and the Allies will not be defeated easily!
Herr General, your forces have moved within striking distance of Antwerpen, your final objective.  Take this city and defeat the Allies now!!!

Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. Despite the overwhelming number of American troops, you managed to pull through very well. I'm afraid that those are the kinds of numbers you will see in the future when you confront the Americans, so hang in there.

Strock: At this crucial point in the war, we cannot allow any incompetent leaders to waste the lives of our men and equipment. Your XO will take over command and you will report immediately to the Chief of Staff in Berlin. Dismissed!

Operaton Torch - The Landing

Well, you dropped the ball this time. The capture of Port Lyautey was really critical to move into Tunisia. Instead, we're still bogged down. We're going to have to go this thing all over again. But this time, with another guy in charge!

Finally you have the chance to meet the Krauts, haven't you? Commander, Jerry is trying to delay at all costs our race to the ports of Tunisia. They know very well that if we seize Tunisia the entire Afrika Korps will be lost. Now the battle is on the Tunisian border, where the British paras have just captured the airfield of Bona. Unfortunately also the German green devils have landed at Bona, and they will attack immediately to regain control of the airport. Your task is to reach at top gear Bona to support the British paratroops and seize all the remaining objectives while the Axis reinforcements are moving against you.
Excellent, you hit a home run! The Nazi have been stunned by your superior leadership. Nice going, commander.

Axis forces are converging towards the Kasserine Pass, commander, and they have a real chance to capture even Thebessa. Also once again Gafsa is in high danger, and possibly we'll not be able to hold it. You should focus your counter strikes first on the powerful German tanks, but be sure to give enough air defence covering to your army, or you'll be wiped out very shortly. This is the hardest mission you have yet to participate in: if you score a victory here, you will be surely promoted!

Here we are, commander: we have the chance to write the final chapter of this African campaign and force the Axis to leave the continent. You are to act a key role in the capture of Tunis, but it won't be really easy since Berlin sent a lot of reinforcements to defend the last toehold of the Axis in Tunisia. You'll have to face a very experienced and entrenched enemy, able to destroy even the best units within your army. So be very cautious in managing your advance, or you will suffer heavy losses.

We are about to launch Operation Husky, the invasion of Sicily. You are to give support to the Bradley 2nd US Corps in assaulting the beaches around the port of Gela. Our marines have just landed at Scoglitti, but the main bulk of this mission lies on your shoulders: rough terrain and enemy entrenched positions will be the biggest problems to deal with. Most of all you will not be able to rely on your formidable air force until you capture the airfield of Ragusa. Therefore this should be the very first objective on your schedule. Good luck!

Commander, after securing our positions around Salerno, it's time to breakout the German defence line and advance fast towards the city of Naples. Pay attention because recognition reports that the enemy positions in front of you are still very strong, supported by heavy armour and artillery. It will be quite tough for your infantry, who anyway is expected to act a key role in this battle. Good luck, son!

General, we are pressing the Axis all over the front but bad weather and rough terrain conditions represent a formidable ally for the Krauts. In the attempt to gain time and put up a strong defence line across central Italy, feldmarschall Kesselring has placed a strong and well entrenched contingent to guard the Volturno River and the nearby mountains, covering the retreat of his fascist comrades. Your task is to break the enemy positions over the Volturno, cross the river and capture the cities of Capua and Castel Volturno as fast as possible.
Battle of the Bulge (#12)

Well, althought it appears that you did manage to take all the objectives, the enemy has withdrawn and regrouped, and now await us some 20 miles down the road. Next time we need a decisive victory from you.
Operation Shingle - The Anzio Beachhead

The General Staff has just decided to play a bold card on the table, commander: you are to lead another amphibious assault aimed at Anzio and the nearby villages, just behind the enemy defensive line. The idea is to cut off the way to Rome for the Nazi. If this operation succeeds, the Krauts will be forced to leave the Gustav Line to defend Rome or avoid any encirclement. Anyway, it won't be easy for your forces, since as you well know feldmarschall Kesselring has already demonstrated his ability to prevent our plans and react quickly on the battlefield. So be aware: in a few time your landing force could be challenged by strong enemy counterattacks. Hope that bad weather does not set in or it will be extremely hard.

General, the decisive attack aimed at breaking out the Gustav Line is about to begin. This will be for sure the toughest battle you have yet to participate in. Expect to fight a bloody infantry battle against a very strong enemy, deeply entrenched and dug in a number of die hard bunkers and strategic positions across the Apennines.

Sure, Cassino and the Gustav Line were tough nuts to crack, and you did the job. Anyway a lot op people at HQ think that you performance could have been much more brilliant. Very soon you'll another chance to show your talent.
